places.name: Petra
places.description: The rose-red city half as old as time. Petra is Jordan's most iconic archaeological treasure, a vast ancient city carved into rose-colored sandstone cliffs by the Nabataean civilization.
places.whyVisit: Walk through a lost Nabataean city carved into rose-colored sandstone. The Siq canyon narrows dramatically before revealing the iconic Treasury facade — one of the most breathtaking moments in all of travel.

images.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP for web delivery.

experiences.title: Desert Adventure
experiences.subtitle: The classic south Jordan expedition

suggestedStops.name: Karak Castle & Kings Highway
suggestedStops.description: En-route stop at the massive 12th-century Crusader fortress standing high above the desert canyon.

suggestedStops.name: Madaba Mosaics & Mount Nebo
suggestedStops.description: Optional morning detachment to view the ancient Byzantine Holy Land mosaic and Moses viewpoint.

suggestedStops.name: Little Petra (Siq al-Barid)
suggestedStops.description: Explore the quieter Nabataean rock suburb, hidden dining caves, and painted frescoes.

suggestedStops.name: Disi Desert Dunes
suggestedStops.description: Optional sunset camel drive through soft white sand dunes before descending to the Red Sea coast.

experiences.description: Jordan's most legendary route. From the rose city of Petra to the Valley of the Moon, this journey through Jordan's south is a cinematic masterpiece of ancient civilizations and desert grandeur.
highlights: Sleep in a Bedouin camp under the stars
Dive in the Red Sea at Aqaba

experiences.title: Northern Heritage Journey
experiences.subtitle: Roman cities and medieval castles

suggestedStops.name: Dibbeen Forest Reserve
suggestedStops.description: Shaded oak and Aleppo pine forest trails perfect for an impromptu picnic surrounded by wildlife.

suggestedStops.name: Pella (Tabaqat Fahl)
suggestedStops.description: Rarely visited ancient Decapolis ruins nestled in the lush Jordan Valley foothill slopes.

experiences.description: Trace the footsteps of Romans, Crusaders, and the great Arab commanders who shaped this landscape. The north of Jordan hides some of the finest ancient ruins in the world.
highlights: Watch sunset from Jerash's Temple of Artemis
Lunch at a local farmhouse in the olive groves

experiences.title: Nature & Canyon Escape
experiences.subtitle: Jordan's living wilderness

suggestedStops.name: Wadi Bin Hammad Canyon
suggestedStops.description: An uncrowded warm water slot canyon with hanging gardens and blood-red sandstone cliffs.

suggestedStops.name: Dead Sea Panorama Complex
suggestedStops.description: Perched high on the cliff edge with a museum and dramatic sunset vantage point over the salt sea.

experiences.description: From ancient stone villages on canyon's edge to rushing slot canyons and the saltiest sea on Earth — Jordan's natural world is astonishing in its range and drama.
highlights: Hike the Wadi Dana trail at dawn
Float on the Dead Sea at sunset
Spot Nubian ibex in the wild

experiences.title: Spiritual Pilgrimage
experiences.subtitle: Along the ancient faith routes

suggestedStops.name: Tell el-Kharrar (Elijah Hill)
suggestedStops.description: The sacred hill where Elijah is believed to have ascended to heaven in a chariot of fire.

suggestedStops.name: Ma'in Thermal Hot Springs
suggestedStops.description: Optional afternoon soak in natural hot waterfalls flowing down volcanic cliffs into natural pools.

experiences.description: Follow the ancient pathways of prophets and pilgrims through the heart of the Holy Land. Jordan holds some of the most sacred sites in the world, and many remain beautifully uncrowded.
highlights: Stand at the Baptism Site of Jesus
Survey three countries from Mount Nebo
Marvel at Byzantine mosaics in Madaba
Relax beside the waters of the Dead Sea
